mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthened economic demand, boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, S&P 500 forward returns decline over the next 20 trading days due to increased borrowing costs.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns remain positive in > 40% of periods with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and PAYEMS growth slows below 0.5% MoM, S&P 500 forward returns decline over the next 5 trading days due to labor market concerns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months and PAYEMS growth < 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS exceeds its 6-month moving average, signaling strengthened retail sales, S&P 500 forward returns increase over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 45% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when FEDFUNDS is below 1% and CPIAUCSL growth accelerates above 0.5% MoM, S&P 500 forward returns increase over the next 20 trading days due to accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in UNRATE below 6% signals a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward SPX returns are negative in > 40% of triggered periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in HOUST, indicating strengthened housing market, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.
